name: USB Audio Out (Master to Computer)
author: Jonathan Robichaud
description: Experimental. In standalone mode, the computer on the USB-B port sees a sound card input, 'EngineX Master Out' (48 kHz stereo, from EngineX's Live Stream; set Live Stream to ON). It carries what Engine's set recorder gets (before the master volume knob) with EngineX's master effects added, using a patched EngineX hook (5.3.0.4 or 5.3.0.5); Engine restarts once when it is first enabled. Takes the USB-B port while enabled. Built for the SC LIVE 4.
